highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 previews Skia m156 with native GTK4 GPU drawing.
highlights_body: GTK4 gains a GPU control and explicit high-DPI painting behavior, Linux NoDependencies discovers installed fonts again, and Tizen moves to a version 10 baseline. Review the Tizen and GTK4 migration notes before upgrading.

breaking.title: Tizen packages require Tizen 10
breaking.body: The Tizen native packages now target `net10.0-tizen10.0`, and the managed minimum rises to Tizen 10. Older Tizen targets are no longer included. Retarget the application and its manifest to Tizen 10, or keep a compatible earlier package for older devices; non-Tizen .NET minimums are unchanged.

breaking.title: GTK4 raster drawing defaults to physical pixels
breaking.body: `SKDrawingArea` now sizes its backing surface, `CanvasSize`, and paint-event `Info` in physical pixels on high-DPI displays. Set `IgnorePixelScaling = true` for logical paint coordinates; `RawInfo` remains physical. GTK input coordinates are always logical, so adjust coordinate conversion and remove any application scaling that would otherwise be applied twice.

bullets.detail: The bundled renderer moves to Skia m156 without adding managed bindings. HarfBuzzSharp's milestone package revision becomes 14.4.0.100 while the bundled HarfBuzz engine remains 14.4.0.

`SKGLArea` provides `PaintSurface`, `GRContext`, `EnableRenderLoop`, and `IgnorePixelScaling` on a GTK-owned OpenGL or OpenGL ES context. Use GTK's `QueueRender()` for invalidation. The control requires a working GPU context and has no software fallback.

The default font manager scans `/usr/share/fonts/` instead of returning empty typefaces when fontconfig is absent, restoring family-based font lookup and shaping with installed fonts without adding a fontconfig dependency.
.NET 11 targets select Emscripten 6.0.2 native assets for SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp. Existing .NET 8 and .NET 9/10 asset mappings are unchanged.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored system-font discovery for Linux NoDependencies native assets

preview_summaries.v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10: Preview 1 introduces Skia m156, GTK4 GPU drawing and high-DPI coordinate handling, Tizen 10 packages, restored Linux NoDependencies font discovery, and updated .NET 11 WebAssembly assets.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100 keeps the native HarfBuzz 14.4.0 engine. Its Tizen packages require Tizen 10, and its .NET 11 WebAssembly targets use the matching Emscripten 6.0.2 archives.

v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10.headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 previews Skia m156 with GTK4 GPU drawing and a Tizen 10 baseline.
v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10.body: Linux NoDependencies font discovery is restored, and WebAssembly assets are aligned with .NET 11. GTK4 applications should review the high-DPI coordinate migration.
